sam: Quick flag — during q4 bringup we saw embedding similarity drift for paraphrase clusters when inputs >1500 tokens. small but consistent.
omar: Can you quantify? baseline vs q8?
sam: Rough numbers: 0.86 -> 0.81 avg cosine on golden-embed-longset (n=400). top-1 rerank gap for retrieval cases 3.5% worse.
rachel: That matches a few validation failures I saw. Might be tokenizer/byte-pair mismatch after quant kernel changes.
jia: Do we already have a curated long-embed golden? I think we only had generation golden.
sam: Not yet. Proposing: build a long-embed-gold_01 of ~400 pairs (query+doc) focusing on paraphrase/legal/code and config templates. Include hard negatives from recent queries.
elena: Labeling rules for emb set: mark "semantically-equal" only if meaning unchanged; for code prefer exact string-match when snippet is syntax-critical. I'll draft short guide.
tony: I'll re-run embed pipeline with kv-cache disabled and with alternate tokenizer merge ops. Also try two quant knobs: q4_0-v1 and q4_0-v2 with revised kernel selection. Commands:
```bash
./eval/embed_eval.sh --model q4_0-v1 --pairs long_pairs.json --out out/v1.json
./eval/embed_eval.sh --model q4_0-v2 --pairs long_pairs.json --out out/v2.json
```
ml-ops-bot: job embed-1749999001 started (pool-011) ETA ~22m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: Also need dedupe fingerprint note: for long docs, current rolling window drops overlapping sentences; that can cause hard negatives to be considered duplicates in curation. Suggest increase window to 4096 for curation-only path.
omar: We should shadow the fingerprint change for 48h. Rachel, can you add a shadow rule in dedupe service?
rachel: On it. will push shadow rule token_count>1200 -> window=4096 and log collisions to bigquery.
jia: Timeline: sam assemble candidate pairs today, labelers 72h, Tony runs embed sweep and posts confusion + per-pair cosine diffs. After 48h shadow, we'll decide whether to treat as model regress or curation artifact.
elena: I'll add three annotation flags: "sem-eq", "verbatim-required", "syntax-critical" with short descriptions in the UI.
annotator-bot: new job curate-long-embeds created and assigned to group annotators (est 60 tasks)
tony: started first run, posting artifacts when done.
ml-ops-bot: job embed-1749999001 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/embed/1749999001/results.tar.gz
sam: pulling artifacts now, will post summary next.
